newsitem.title: USA: PECO Limerick 2 Pa. nuke shut for repairs.
newsitem.headline: PECO Limerick 2 Pa. nuke shut for repairs.

text.p: PECO Energy Co shut its 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick 2 nuclear power plant to repair a seal that was allowing air to leak into the unit's main condenser, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Thursday.
The NRC, citing a status report from the plant's operator, said the unit likely would be restarted December 22.
The unit, in Pottstown, Pa., is currently in hot shutdown, which typically indicates a prompt restart is expected.
The unit's output was reduced to about 40 percent of its generation capacity this past weekend to correct a problem with its exhaust gas system.
The facility's neighboring unit, Limerick 1, was operating at its full 1,055 MW capacity, the NRC said.
